description_en: Modifies the parameters of an instance associated with an Express Connect Router (ECR)
description_zh: 修改专线网关ECR（Express Connect Router）关联的子实例属性
kebab_example: aliyun expressconnectrouter modify-express-connect-router-association --ecr-id ecr-mezk2idmsd0vx20000 --association-id ecr-assoc-9p2qxx5phpca2m0000 --region cn-hangzhou
name: ModifyExpressConnectRouterAssociation

parameters.help_en: The ID of the association between ECR and the VPC or TR
parameters.name: association_id

parameters.help_en: The description of the child instance. The description must be 0 to 128 characters in length
parameters.help_zh: 子实例的描述信息。长度为0～128个字符
parameters.name: description

parameters.help_en:
Specifies whether to perform a dry run. Valid values:

true: performs a dry run but does not modify the service resource.
false (default): sends a normal request
parameters.help_zh:
是否只预检此次请求。取值：

true：发送检查请求，不会修改服务资源。

false（默认值）：发送正常请求
parameters.name: dry_run

parameters.help_en:
The client token that is used to ensure the idempotence of the request.

You can use the client to generate a token, but you must make sure that the token is unique among different requests. The ClientToken parameter can contain only ASCII characters.

When left empty, the system automatically uses the request ID as the client token. The request ID for each request is unique
parameters.help_zh:
客户端Token，用于保证请求的幂等性。

从您的客户端生成一个参数值，确保不同请求间该参数值唯一。ClientToken只支持ASCII字符。


若您未指定，则系统自动使用API请求的RequestId作为ClientToken标识。每次API请求的RequestId不一样
parameters.name: client_token

AccessDeniedDetail.description_en: The details of the access denial

Code.description_en: Indicates whether the call is successful. A value of 200 indicates that the call is successful. Other values indicate that the call failed. For more information about the cause of a failure, see the "Error codes" section
Code.description_zh: 判断调用是否成功。返回值为200表示成功，返回其他值表示失败，失败原因参见错误码

DynamicMessage.description_en:
The dynamic error message that is used to replace the `%s` placeholder in the error message.

If the ErrMessage parameter returns The Value of Input Parameter %s is not valid and the DynamicMessage parameter returns DtsJobId, the specified DtsJobId parameter is invalid
DynamicMessage.description_zh:
动态错误信息，用于替换返回参数ErrMessage错误信息中的`%s`。
如果ErrMessage返回The Value of Input Parameter %s is not valid，且DynamicMessage返回DtsJobId，则代表所传入的请求参数DtsJobId不合法
DynamicMessage.example: The param format of EcrId **** is illegal.

Message.description_en: The message returned for the operation

Success.description_en:
Indicates whether the call is successful. Valid values:

True
False
Success.description_zh:
是否调用成功。取值：
True：成功。
False：失败
